metadata.title: Vintage Sepia Country Music Album Layout

retrievalProfile.description: A centered, framed black-and-white photograph set against a larger, weathered sepia paper background with elegant script and serif typography.
triggerTerms: country music aesthetic with script typography
distressed paper texture with centered photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central monochrome photograph enclosed in a thin double-line border, placed atop a heavily textured, yellowed, and creased paper background. The layout uses a vertical hierarchy with flowing script at the top and structured serif type at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Framed central subject vs. expansive textured background
Monochrome photo vs. warm sepia paper tones
Fluid calligraphic script vs. rigid serif display type
Sharp photographic detail vs. soft weathered paper edges
coreInvariants: Thin double-line rectangular frame around the central image
Heavily distressed paper texture with visible creases and stains
Sepia-toned color palette for the outer margins

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure is vertically oriented, occupying the middle third of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central framed photograph acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the script title to the central image, ending at the bold name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the wide paper margins surrounding the central frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast in the central photo, low value contrast in the background texture.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of elegant copperplate script and classical Roman serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top text: High-contrast script with long, looping ascenders and descenders.
Bottom text: All-caps serif with bracketed serifs and moderate stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the first and last letters of the script line
Decorative flourishes/underlines beneath the bottom serif text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a delicate, organic script with a structured, authoritative serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast loops of the top text.
Provides the classical, all-caps serif look for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a weathered, yellowed paper texture with creases and stains. In the center, place a black-and-white photograph of a subject in a rural setting, enclosed in a thin dark-brown double-line frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of elegant, looping script text in dark brown at the top center. Add a line of wide-tracked, all-caps serif text in dark brown at the bottom center, accompanied by decorative flourishes.

verificationChecks: Is the background paper visibly aged and sepia-toned?
Are there two distinct font styles (script and serif)?
Is the thin double-line frame present around the photo?

adjustableVariables: Contrast level of the central photo
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic paper creases crossing the frame.
Ensure the script text doesn't look like a standard computer font (add slight irregularities).
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the margins.
Confirm the central image is desaturated compared to the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central monochrome photo + thin double frame + weathered sepia paper background + (Top: Script / Bottom: Serif) typography.
